Stored key A (Both I and IV) contradicts the standard closure result that half(L) is regular whenever L is regular; only repeat(L) can be non-regular, so the provable answer is B (Only I).

fixes.after: Stored key A claims half(L) can be non-regular, but half(L) is always regular for regular L (DFA on pairs (state, set of states reaching F in |u| steps)); prefix and suffix are also closed. Only repeat(L) can be non-regular (repeat((a+b)*) = {ww}). Provable answer: B (Only I). Key not changed because no official key is available.
